Re-verified 2026-09-17 against https://docs.bfl.ai/quick_start/pricing (page lastModified 2026-09-15). Official basis: "1 credit = $0.01 USD". FLUX 3 video is now tiered by mode (t2v / i2v / v2v) and resolution class (hd / fhd / qhd / uhd) plus a draft rate; the catalog flux-3 pricing was replaced with the full official 3x5 table (t2v and i2v hd $0.17/s, fhd $0.29/s, qhd $0.40/s, uhd $0.80/s, draft $0.06/s; v2v hd $0.41/s, fhd $0.53/s, qhd $0.65/s, uhd $0.95/s, draft $0.12/s). FLUX.2 pricing is per output megapixel: klein 4B and klein 9B were restructured into first-megapixel / additional-megapixel tiers matching the official Klein example, flux-2-pro now carries separate text_to_image ($0.03) and image_editing ($0.045) rows, and flux-2-max ($0.07) and flux-2-flex ($0.05) keep a single row because BFL prices text-to-image and editing identically. The previously recorded input-side megapixel rows for pro/max had no support on the official page and were dropped. Added the five officially priced FLUX.1 previous-generation models (Kontext pro $0.04, Kontext max $0.08, FLUX1.1 pro $0.04, FLUX1.1 pro Ultra $0.06, Fill pro $0.05) and FLUX.2 [dev] as catalog_only (official: "Local only ... no hosted API"). Not added: FLUX Video Upscale ($0.07/$0.10 per megapixel-second), FLUX Video Edit [fast] ($0.03 per second) and the flux-tools endpoints, which are tools rather than models; the /v1/flux-dev and /v1/flux-2-pro-preview endpoints, which the pricing page does not price as separate models; and flux-2-klein-9b-kv-finetuned, a public-beta fine-tuned endpoint billed identically to its base model.

Re-verified 2026-09-17. platform.stability.ai/pricing is a Cloudflare-protected JS SPA that returns only a shell, so the official pricing table was extracted from the same site's data bundle (https://platform.stability.ai/assets/index-eklWmhUz.js, IMAGE_SERVICES / AUDIO_SERVICES / THREE_D_SERVICES arrays) and cross-checked against the docs billing note "additional credits can be purchased ... at a rate of $1 USD per 100 credits" (1 credit = $0.01). Audio: Stable Audio 3.0 26 credits, Stable Audio 2.5 20 credits — both match the catalog unchanged. Generate: Stable Image Ultra 8 credits and Stable Image Core 3 credits — both match unchanged; Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large 6.5, Large Turbo 4, Medium 3.5 and Flash 2.5 credits were added as new models with per-image USD rows; SDXL 1.0 is listed only as "From 0.9" credits with variable steps, so it is catalog_only + hidden with no price row. No Stability model was retired: the July 24 2025 deprecation notice removed only the Stable Video and Stable Diffusion 1.6 endpoints, neither of which is in this catalog. Unconfirmed: the official audio table has no separate SFX SKU (only Stable Audio 3.0 and Stable Audio 2.5 text-to-audio), so stable-audio-2.5-sfx keeps its existing 20-credit-derived $0.20 row; and Upscale / Edit / Control operations plus the 3D services (Stable Fast 3D 10 credits, Stable Point Aware 3D 4 credits) were not added because they are operations/models whose capability is outside this region's declared vendor capabilities.

Re-verified 2026-09-17 against the official Mureka API platform documentation (https://platform.mureka.ai/docs/, /docs/en/quickstart.html, /docs/en/faq.html, /docs/en/changelog.html and the api-reference operation pages). The OpenAPI model enum embedded in the docs bundle is the authoritative on-sale list: song / easy-generate / soundtrack accept auto, mureka-7.6, mureka-o2, mureka-8, mureka-9, mureka-9.5; instrumental accepts auto, mureka-7.6, mureka-8, mureka-9, mureka-9.5. Catalog ids match those vendor ids 1:1 for the o-series (mureka-o2) but prefix the versioned ids with a "v" (catalog mureka-v7.6 vs vendor mureka-7.6, and likewise v8 / v9 / v9.5); this pre-existing naming convention was left untouched and the vendor-side strings are quote-able from the official signature and response examples. mureka-v7.5, mureka-o1 and mureka-o3 were downgraded to deprecated/hidden/catalog_only because their vendor ids are absent from the current enum (mureka-o3 has no occurrence anywhere on the official site). No official monetary price list exists on any reachable Mureka page (the FAQ pricing section only covers top-up validity, and /v1/account/billing returns account balances rather than rates), so all eight existing api_result rates are left untouched and reported as unconfirmed.

Re-verified 2026-09-17 against https://suno.com/pricing. The plans comparison lists "Best free model (v6-mini)" for Free and "Advanced models (v6 and v6-wild)" for Pro and Premier, and the model-version FAQ states "v6 and v6-wild are our top models, available only to Pro and Premier users. v6-mini is a faster, more efficient model available to free users." The v6 family is therefore recorded, but only subscription credits (Pro 2,500/month, Premier 10,000/month) are published — there is no official per-second or per-generation API rate, so no pricing files were created and the three v6 models are catalog_only + hidden per the patch contract. suno-v5 and suno-v5.5 are downgraded to deprecated/hidden/catalog_only; their existing music_output_second rates (0.025000 and 0.020000 USD) could not be corroborated by any official price page and are flagged as unconfirmed rather than changed. Note that the marketing FAQ on https://suno.com/api still advertises v5.5, which conflicts with the plans page; the plans page was treated as authoritative.
